name: hikari-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is hikari, a statically typed Discord API library for Python built on asyncio.
Its event system turns gateway payloads into typed event objects and delivers them to listeners and event
streams: `GatewayBot` hosts an event manager (`listen`, `subscribe`, `unsubscribe`, `get_listeners`,
`dispatch`, `wait_for`, `stream`) and an event factory, while a RESTBot receives interactions through the
interaction server instead.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the event system of hikari: the event classes in hikari/events/, the event manager and event factory interfaces and implementations (hikari/api/event_manager.py, hikari/api/event_factory.py, hikari/impl/event_manager_base.py, hikari/impl/event_manager.py and hikari/impl/event_factory.py), the GatewayBot that hosts them (hikari/impl/gateway_bot.py), the interaction server that delivers interactions to a RESTBot (hikari/api/interaction_server.py and hikari/impl/interaction_server.py), the lazy iterator base of event streams (hikari/iterators.py) and the modules they build on (hikari/intents.py, hikari/traits.py, hikari/snowflakes.py, hikari/undefined.py, the package root hikari/__init__.py and the internal utility package hikari/internal/), together with README.md, examples/hello_world.py and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
